subject: Attention
source_sentence: The model obtains contextual information by BiLSTM and then by Attention and Edge-Label guided Graph Convolution Network (AELGCN) to integrate better contextual and structured information.
title: Attention and Edge-Label Guided Graph Convolutional Networks for Named Entity Recognition

subject: Experiments
source_sentence: We have conducted extensive experiments on standard datasets across four languages.
title: Attention and Edge-Label Guided Graph Convolutional Networks for Named Entity Recognition

subject: BiLSTM
source_sentence: The BiLSTM enables the model to get contextual information from both directions
title: Attention and Edge-Label Guided Graph Convolutional Networks for Named Entity Recognition

subject: CRF
source_sentence: The CRF takes vectors in the tagging space as input and produces the best sequence of labels using the Viterbi algorithm.
title: Attention and Edge-Label Guided Graph Convolutional Networks for Named Entity Recognition

subject: Catalan

subject: Spanish

subject: OntoNotes

subject: BERT

subject: CharacTer
source_sentence: For the character embeddings, we randomly initialize the character embeddings, set the dimension as 30, and set the hidden size of character-level BiLSTM as 50.
title: Attention and Edge-Label Guided Graph Convolutional Networks for Named Entity Recognition

subject: dependency
source_sentence: For the dependency label embeddings, we randomly initialize dependency label embeddings with 50-dimension vectors and dependency label embedding adjacency matrix embeddings as 50.
title: Attention and Edge-Label Guided Graph Convolutional Networks for Named Entity Recognition

subject: BiLSTM

title: Attention and Edge-Label Guided Graph Convolutional Networks for Named Entity Recognition

subject: Models
source_sentence: Our models are optimized by mini-batch stochastic gradient descent (SGD) with a learning rate of 0.1 and batch size of 20.
title: Attention and Edge-Label Guided Graph Convolutional Networks for Named Entity Recognition
